messages:

Cc: payments@saffrontech.com

Subject: New vendor onboarding — Saffron Tech (banking & PO questions)

Hi Hannah / Marissa,

Thanks for the quick turnaround on the onboarding form last week. We're finishing our internal procurement steps and want to get payment routing and PO mapping aligned before the first invoice. A few quick asks so we can close the loop from our side:

- Can you confirm where Redwood expects the PO number on invoices (invoice header, line item, or invoice body)?
- Any preferred remit format (structured remit CSV vs. PO string)? We can provide either.
- We'll upload our W-9 and bank letter — want to confirm a micro-deposit test is acceptable as part of ACH verification.

I've attached our initial W-9 and a copy of our bank letter for reference. We'll also send the Vendor Onboarding form (filled) back if you prefer Redwood's template — either works.

Planned timeline: we can get everything to you by COB tomorrow. Would like Redwood to process the micro-deposit verification and confirm the first invoice route/PO tagging so our billing can proceed.

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Head of Finance Ops
Saffron Tech
attachments: Saffron_W9.pdf, bank-letter-signed.pdf

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@saffrontech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 Mar 2025 10:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — Saffron Tech (banking & PO questions)

Hi Liam — thanks for the materials, and welcome. Short answers and next steps below.

1) PO placement: Redwood Finance prefers PO# in the invoice header (Invoice: "PO#: 12345"). If you must include on line items, we can accept that too; header is easier for automated reconciliation.

2) Remit format: We can accept a structured CSV (preferred) or an embedded PO string. If you send a sample CSV, our AR team will validate the columns.

3) Micro-deposit: that's fine. Please send ACH credentials and we'll schedule a $0.10 test deposit to confirm routing. Expect validation within 24–48 hours after the micro-deposit clears.

Attached: Vendor_Onboarding_Form_FILLABLE.pdf (please fill and return). Also attaching a remit-mapping-sample.csv that shows the columns we use (PO, InvoiceNumber, InvoiceDate, Amount, SupplierRef).

Action items for Saffron:
- Return the filled onboarding form + preferred remit format (CSV or PO string)
- Confirm ACH routing (account number, routing number, and whether account is checking/savings)
- Confirm the name that will appear on the micro-deposit (makes reconciliation easier)

We'll kick finance to initiate the micro-deposit once we receive the filled form and ACH details. Ben (cc'd) will own the deposit and verification.

Cheers,
Hannah Schmitt
Manager, Strategic Procurement
Redwood Inference
attachments: Vendor_Onboarding_Form_FILLABLE.pdf, remit-mapping-sample.csv

Thanks — we received the completed onboarding form and the bank docs. I initiated a $0.10 ACH micro-deposit from Redwood (Originator: RedwoodInference PAY) at 14:00 ET just now. Please monitor your incoming items — it should post within 24 hours, sometimes sooner depending on banks.

We matched the remit mapping to: PO -> field "PO" in the attached sample CSV (remit-mapping-sample.csv). For your first invoice, please include the PO# in the invoice header exactly as "PO#: <number>". We'll reconcile automatically and release payment on our next scheduled cycle once the micro-deposit is validated.

When you see the deposit, reply with the exact amount (e.g., 0.10) or send a screenshot of your incoming activity. I've also attached a short bankproof stub we keep for the vendor file. Once verified, I'll update the vendor record in the payops portal and confirm the payment window.

Thanks — excited to have Saffron live.

Ben Carter
Senior Payments Analyst, Redwood Inference
